Review of PR #28 "Design Changes 5c" (lovable-sync ce5954d vs main 6d54ecd, 5 commits by gpt-engineer-app[bot])

Brief: /home/user/mychata/docs/tasks/T-028-l5c-public-pages.md. Lovable's report is in the PR at docs/external/lovable/2026-10-14-l5c-public-pages.md.

## Findings, most severe first

**1. Medium: the onboarding account-type selector changes behaviour, not just the look.** `src/routes/onboarding.tsx:230-253` (head) adds "Rodina" / "Instituce / Organizace" buttons that call `setType(...)`.

- The code comment at onboarding.tsx:62-63 says the account type "is decided at sign-up (T-021)": the institution sign-up stores `signup_kind`, and everyone else is a family. This PR makes the type changeable after sign-up.
- The server doesn't check the type. `create_account_onboarding` (drizzle/migrations/0011_multi_account_tenancy.sql:200-204) only checks that `_type` is FAMILY or INSTITUTIONAL. The only gate is the client-side `isPublicEmailDomain` check.
- Failure scenario 1: someone signs in with Google using a company-domain address, taps "Instituce" and gets an INSTITUTIONAL account. That account has institution features (public request form, approvals) without going through the institution sign-up.
- Failure scenario 2: someone who signed up as an institution taps "Rodina" and silently creates a family account.
- Failure scenario 3 (race): the effect at lines 71-77 re-runs when `profile?.display_name` arrives. A user who taps "Rodina" before the profile loads is switched back to INSTITUTIONAL.
- This is the brief's wording ("choosing Instituce/Organizace") read as "add a choice". It is not a tenancy breach, since the person only creates their own new account. But it is product/auth logic, which Lovable may not change. A human should decide: keep it, or remove it so the type stays read-only from `signup_kind`.

**2. Medium (the PR's own claims): `bun run check` was never run by anyone.**

- The PR's Verification section is empty.
- Lovable's report says "Manual `bun run check` and `bun run build` were not run", so typecheck was never run. The lint, format, test and docs:check outputs it pastes are summaries, not full logs.
- I could not run it either (see "Not verified"). Do not merge until the CI job "check" is green on ce5954d.

**3. Low (the PR's own claims): roadmap.md marks unfinished items as done.**

- roadmap.md:5 ticks "[x] Check contrast, brands, cookie position…".
- The report itself says the cookie banner was not checked on invitation and other public-token pages. Blue was a token-only preview with no real institution account. The calendar's `--faint` text fails 4.5:1 (2.25 / 2.28).
- Several brief acceptance items are also unmet: every route at 375/768/1280, and every page state for host, pozvanka, manual and zadost. The report admits this. The tick should be partial, or left unticked.

**4. Low: the "Flag as outdated" button on the public manual can fail silently** (`src/routes/verejne.manual.$token.tsx`, `flag` useMutation around lines 46-58).

- It has `onSuccess` but no `onError`. If the RPC fails, a guest who taps "Nahlásit neaktuální" sees nothing happen (invariant 6).
- This existed before the PR. The PR restyled that button but didn't fix it.

**5. Low: the onboarding answers save ignores errors** (`src/routes/onboarding.tsx`, in `finish()`).

- `await supabase.from("onboarding_answers").upsert(...)` doesn't check `error`. This existed before the PR and isn't in the diff, but the file is in scope.

**6. Low: the landing page shows sign-in buttons to signed-in users** (`src/routes/index.tsx:76-86`).

- It now shows "Přihlásit se" and "Obnovení hesla" buttons on a screen that redirects signed-in users and still says "Otevírám vaši chatu". A signed-in user briefly sees sign-in buttons under a "loading your account" headline.
- Linking to reset-password from the landing page is odd. The report notes the redirect is out of scope.

**7. Low: hero image size attributes don't match the image** (`src/routes/index.tsx:60-61`, `src/routes/auth.tsx:270-271`).

- `width={1200} height={1200}` declares a square image, but it is shown at 16:10 / 250px high. CSS sets the box, so there is no layout shift, but the numbers are wrong (previously 1024x640). I did not check the real photo sizes in src/lib/season.ts.

**8. Low / maybe-lint: the same module is imported twice in `src/routes/__root.tsx`.**

- Line 3 imports from `@/lib/i18n`; line 176 (existing) imports `LanguageProvider` from `../lib/i18n`. This may be one of the 13 lint warnings Lovable reports.

**9. Info: a live test cottage was changed.** The report says copying the calendar link "called the existing enable-public-calendar action; its link remains enabled" on "Testovací chata (Lovable)". That is allowed under invariant 8, but someone should know the test cottage's public calendar is now on.

## Checklist results

**Tenancy:** no migrations, SQL, policies, SECURITY DEFINER functions or grants.

- The public token routes call the same RPCs as before (`public_property`, `public_calendar`, `public_manual`, `public_flag_manual_section`, `getGuestLinkInfo`). The changes only add `isError` UI.
- Nothing new is reachable by anonymous users.
- og/title/description tags on all nine routes are fixed Czech strings. None contain cottage names, tokens or other private data. `robots: noindex` is kept where it was before.

**Correctness:**

- Every Supabase call in the diff checks `error`. The new error states use the `isError` flags.
- No `alert()`.
- No route changes; routes.md has no titles, so `docs:gen` isn't needed.
- No type or schema changes.
- The CSS tokens and utilities used (`label-text`, `bg-destructive-soft`, `text-warn-foreground`, `bg-primary-soft`, `page-fresh`) exist in src/styles.css.
- `Button` variant and size "fresh" exist. None of the changed buttons are inside a `<form>`, so their default type="submit" does nothing.

**Language and tap targets:**

- All new user-facing text goes through `t("cs","en")`, Czech first.
- The error-page.ts fallback is plain HTML with Czech first, English below, and `lang="cs"`.
- Placeholders that used to be hard-coded "E-mail" now go through `t()`.
- Tap targets are at least 44px: size-11, min-h-11 or min-h-14, and fresh pills of 52px in the fallback page.

**Invariants:**

- No secrets.
- No personal data: I grepped the added lines for e-mail and phone patterns and found nothing. The report names only "Testovací chata (Lovable)".

**Scope:**

- All 13 changed files are on the T-028 allowlist. The `__root.tsx` change is limited to NotFoundComponent and ErrorComponent plus imports.
- No changes to drizzle/, supabase/, `*.functions.ts`, src/integrations, .env\*, .github, .claude, docs/decisions, supabase/tests, shared components or styles.css.
- CI files are unchanged, so the job is still "check".
- The only scope issue is the behaviour change in finding 1.
